newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Dec 10.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- A 16-member North Korean family and a security official arrire in Seoul yesterday, ending 44-day flight via China.

- Government, opposition political camps reach agreement on political reform plan, including adoption of conditonal television debates among presidential candidates, and banning the prosecutor general from assuming public posts after leaving office.
- Prosecutors decide to enforce criminal law against workers who strike in protest against government-initiated labor law revision bill.

- North Korea intensifies border area security to prevent its people from crossing over into China or Russia, South Korea's top intelligence official testified during a closed-door parliamentary panel session.

- One South Korean Army Corps commander, 19 others punished for lack of speedy reaction, loose coastal vigilance, friendly fire and other problems related to Noth Korea's September submarine incursion incident.
